# v1.0.12 — S41 generator and archival metadata aligned with the submitted title

This release adds the one reproducibility artefact that was still only in the manuscript's
supplementary material, and aligns the archive's bibliographic metadata with the title now on
the submitted manuscript.

## What changed

- `code/jfa_20_cutoff_table.R` regenerates **Supplementary Table S41**: two-year reproduction
  under three published cut-off sets (AWGS 2019 `<28 / <18 kg`, EWGSOP2 `<27 / <16 kg`,
  FNIH `<26 / <16 kg`) in the 6,052-person landmark sample. It reads `out/jamda_full.rds`,
  writes `out/S41_three_cutoffs.csv`, and prints the gate that the AWGS row reproduces Table 1
  (647 low in 2011; 40.5%, 35.6-45.6; kappa 0.30).
- The script is **not** added to `run_all.sh`: its gate checks published values that hold only
  on the CHARLS cohort, so running it on the synthetic cohort would fail the pipeline. It is a
  generator to be run against the real release, in the spirit of `code/charls_only/`.
- `.zenodo.json` and `CITATION.cff` now carry the submitted title
  "Two-year agreement of a low handgrip strength classification in 9,116 Chinese adults: a single reading is a provisional label" and version 1.0.12. The previous archive still carried the earlier
  6,052-person title.
- `.zenodo.json` gained a 1.0.12 change section; earlier change sections are preserved.

## What did not change

- No estimate, table row or figure value in the manuscript changed.
- `run_all.sh` still runs 57 steps; the pipeline and its CI smoke test are untouched.
- No figure binary, manuscript, cover letter, reviewer document or respondent-level data were
  added. The repository's `.gitignore` excludes submission documents by design.

## Note for the manuscript

The Data/Code availability statement in the submitted manuscript still names version 1.0.11 as
"the version that accompanies this submission". If this release is the one that should accompany
the submission, that sentence and the matching quotation in `DATA_AVAILABILITY.md` need to be
updated to 1.0.12 in the manuscript files (which are not part of this repository).
